basic_info.description: Nestled in one of San Francisco's most iconic neighborhoods, this contemporary 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom Nob Hill retreat offers the perfect balance of tranquility and urban convenience. The main level features an open-concept living area with a wall of floor-to-ceiling windows, inviting natural light and showcasing the private outdoor space. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, including Bosch double ovens, gas cooktop, and Caesarstone counters. The kitchen seamlessly flows into both the dining and living areas with fireplace. A full bathroom and guest bedroom with dual closets complete this level.  The lower level is dedicated to the oversized primary suite, offering a true retreat with its spacious lounge area, built-in closets, bathroom and direct access to the private outdoor patio. The room is framed by large windows, creating an airy and inviting atmosphere. Also on the lower level is an office / flex space, adding to the home's functionality.
